title: 2004 AMC 8 Problem 23
statement: Tess runs counterclockwise around rectangular block \(JKLM.\) She lives at corner \(J.\) Which graph could represent her straight-line distance from home?

solutions.text:
As Tess runs from \(J\) to \(K,\) her distance from home increases.

From \(K\) to \(L,\) her distance continues to increase, but with a different shape, reaching its maximum at the opposite corner \(L.\)

From \(L\) to \(M\) and then from \(M\) back to \(J,\) her distance decreases back to \(0,\) again changing behavior at \(M.\)

Graph \(D\) is the only graph with this increase, changed-rate increase, changed-rate decrease, and final decrease to \(0.\)

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Track the distance from corner \(J\) at each side of the rectangle.
The distance is greatest at the opposite corner \(L.\)
